scope: Mac startup ownership and socket recovery
ownership namespace protection and rg exclusions

findings.finding: FIFO metadata blocks synchronous open before file type validation
findings.resolution: O_NONBLOCK for private ownership file opens; isolated read/write FIFO regression
findings.verification: independent probe rejected in 91ms and preserved FIFO

findings.finding: record growth between fstat and read bypasses the stated size cap
findings.resolution: fixed 4097-byte buffer and bounded read loop; reject above4096 bytes
findings.verification: independent 2MiB-growth injection read4097 bytes and preserved socket

findings.finding: APFS Data-volume alias bypasses ownership-directory sensitive path checks
findings.resolution: protect Data aliases and exclude their namespace from rg; bypass read/write tests
findings.verification: independent guard probe returned not-allowed for Data-volume lock path

findings.finding: existing canonicalRoot allowed Data aliases to hold separate locks; missing-tail spelling and partial mkdir could split startup admission
findings.resolution: physical getcwd path verified by bigint dev/ino; fixed per-user startup gate with bounded wait and post-creation validation; preserve legacy realpath socket aliases
findings.verification: Data alias second acquire rejected; partial-ancestor mkdir and unrelated-root queue tests passed
findings.origin: pre-existing path identity issue affecting this work package

withdrawnInference: Existing-directory case variant double-lock inference was withdrawn: old async realpath already restores stored casing, unlike realpathSync. Data aliases and missing-tail spelling remained real findings.
retainedLimitations: startup gate queues for at most2seconds then fails closed
residual sockets without matching evidence require manual verification
